theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (f ζ : Euclid P → ℝ) (ψ l : ℝ → ℝ) (x v : Euclid P), x ≠ 0 → inner ℝ x v = 0 → DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ (f x) → DifferentiableAt ℝ l ‖x‖ → DifferentiableAt ℝ ζ x → fderiv ℝ (fun y : Euclid P => ψ (f y) * l ‖y‖ * ζ y) x v = ψ (f x) * l ‖x‖ * fderiv ℝ ζ x v + ζ x * l ‖x‖ * (deriv ψ (f x) * fderiv ℝ f x v)
